original.statement: The ContinueReconciliationOnManualRollingUpdateFailure feature gate moves to GA stage and is permanently enabled without the possibility to disable it.

corrected.statement: In Strimzi 0.46.0 the ContinueReconciliationOnManualRollingUpdateFailure feature gate moves to GA and is permanently enabled, with no possibility to disable it.

decision.reason: [ev-173f5593d910] names the feature gate `ContinueReconciliationOnManualRollingUpdateFailure` and says it moves to GA and is "permanently enabled without the possibility to disable it". The subject is right. behavior-changed is a reasonable change type because the evidence does not give a previous default. The proposed after value, "\"enabled\"", has stray quote characters baked into the string and shortens the wording, so it is replaced with the literal "permanently enabled" from the evidence.
